worst_group: race, sex, age; unknown excluded; no support cutoff; fixed labels [0,1]
counterfactual_policy: enumerate other categories; change one attribute at a time; rerun narrative, evidence ablation and final diagnosis; hold image-only reports, tool predictions and CDR fixed
external_probability: saved raw CFP RETFound probability; fixed 0.5 baseline threshold; no test-label normalization
failure_policy: three attempts; cache valid stages; retain missing as missing and forbid incomplete final tables; no negative imputation
limitations: Fresh relative to documented prior live-agent cases, not a new external population
Full-test foundation and deterministic-fusion results were previously inspected
External cohorts were previously evaluated and are not untouched confirmation cohorts
Fusion uses multiple encoders; agent arms are RETFound-anchored
